name: Interv'ju s Legendoj
source:
Progress has come to Legend City: Miles the journalist is on the verge of losing his job to AI!
Fortunately, his boss hasn't lost faith in human ingenuity and gives Miles one week to boost the online magazine's ratings and prove to upper management that he's still worth something.
It’s a "gold star" challenge, but Miles isn't giving up. He has to talk the city's most extraordinary residents into doing an interview.
translation:
传奇之城取得了进展：记者迈尔斯即将被人工智能丢掉工作！
幸运的是，他的老板并没有对人类的聪明才智失去信心，并给了迈尔斯一周的时间来提高在线杂志的收视率，并向高层管理人员证明他仍然有价值。
这是一个“金星”挑战，但迈尔斯并没有放弃。他必须说服这座城市最杰出的居民接受采访。
